All 53 test classes pass cleanly as a single batch.

provenance.note: FD-B10 active-company authorization correction measured at source commit fd14a613c405241d6a7a2ada5dcf127cc18de777: 53 exact Front Desk classes / 409 tests / 1702 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. Dedicated execution-boundary and departure-queue paths now reject missing, empty, unknown, inactive, or cross-company active-company/property context before Front Desk stay/B7, PMS Guest Ledger, or General Cashier source evidence queries. Checkout execution remains can_execute=false; no Front Desk cashier session, guest cash transaction, count, handover, reconciliation, or accountability mutation added.

baselines.description: PMS Cashiering guest payment operational tests covering cash payment intake, allocation, immutable void and allocation reversal evidence, typed source-linked folio effects, authorization, property isolation, idempotency, real worker PostgreSQL concurrency, migration UP/DOWN/REAPPLY proof, ambiguous legacy payment/deposit blocking, source-field immutability trigger, exact source-amount integrity, controlled generic void rejection, composite FK enforcement, and atomic rollback. GLF-B establishes guest payment allocation and immutable reversal foundation only. All 3 test classes pass cleanly as a single batch.

provenance.note: GLF-B deletion closure measurement: 3 classes / 53 tests / 287 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. Real worker concurrency; UP/DOWN/REAPPLY migration proof; exact source amount integrity; controlled generic void rejection; transaction immutability and deletion immutability trigger; atomic rollback evidence; model-level deletion guard; lifecycle-independent deletion blocking; idempotency and payment-number continuity after failed deletion.

baselines.description: General Cashier checkout obligation projection tests covering the immutable GC-A1 read model, exact four-status semantics, authorization-first behavior, property isolation, PMS cash source linkage, source fingerprint sensitivity, zero-write proof, top-level read-only transaction guard, and deterministic repeatable-read worker concurrency proof. All 1 exact test class passes cleanly as a single batch.

provenance.note: Snapshot-completeness correction measurement: 1 exact GC-A1 class / 38 tests / 231 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. Projection remains General Cashier-owned, read-only, authorization-first, active-company and property-scoped, and fail-closed when session-scoped accountability evidence is unavailable. Snapshot validation now requires every canonical payment, deposit, refund, allocation/application, void, and reversal source-snapshot key supplied by the expected-field contract. Missing keys, empty snapshots, malformed amounts, absent payment opened_at, missing deposit application folio_number, and incomplete reversal evidence all fail closed as review-required and preserve conservative relevance. Fingerprint coverage changes when required snapshot evidence is removed while evaluated_at remains excluded. Historical OPEN to current CLOSED cashier sessions remain evidence-unavailable rather than snapshot conflicts. No Front Desk integration, checkout execution, cashier mutation, handover, count, reconciliation, folio mutation, Business Date, or Night Audit behavior added.

baselines.description: GLF-C PostgreSQL tests covering source-proven CASH guest deposits, partial/full/split application, immutable application reversal and unused-deposit void, Payment/Deposit-bounded cash refunds, PMS Guest Ledger AR-transfer requests, Accounting/AR accept/reject/reverse decisions, typed source-linked Folio effects, canonical Deposit/AR totals, database partial unique source indexes on folio_items (deposit_application, deposit_reversal, ar_decision), source-uniqueness SQLSTATE 23505/P0001 proof, duplicate-source-effect worker concurrency proof, full confirmation-failure matrix (deposit void, deposit reversal, cash refund, AR accept, AR reject, AR reverse), 12 cross-property non-disclosure sub-cases, accepted lock order (Deposit → Folio → Application → Reversal), thirteen real worker concurrency races, and disposable migration UP/DOWN/REAPPLY plus ambiguous legacy Deposit blocking. All 5 exact classes pass cleanly as one batch.

provenance.note: Commit 3 measurement: 5 exact GLF-C classes / 30 tests / 326 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. Database source uniqueness indexes (deposit_app, deposit_reversal, ar_decision) with item_type-scoped WHERE predicates. Duplicate-source worker concurrency proof with distinct PHP/PG PIDs. Full confirmation-failure matrix proven. 12 cross-property non-disclosure sub-cases proven with ModelNotFoundException parity. UP/DOWN/REAPPLY migration proof extended with index verification. GLF-A (43/186), GLF-B (53/287), Sensitive/Finance (58/436) all preserved. No accepted debt.

baselines.description: PMS Guest Ledger settlement readiness projection tests covering output contract, status precedence, multi-folio evaluation, fresh-vs-cached totals, payment/deposit/refund/AR transfer resolution, external evidence ports, authorization, property isolation, zero-write proof, BCMath precision, and real worker concurrency proof. provenance.note: GLF-D deterministic snapshot closure: 3 exact classes / 60 tests / 253 assertions / 0 failures / 0 errors. Deterministic two-phase barrier replaces usleep: blocking PostingCompleteness port writes snapshot-established inside REPEATABLE READ transaction after all financial-source reads; mutator waits, executes, writes mutation-committed. Pre/post projection oracles for every race prove worker projection equals exact pre-mutation result and rejects mixed-source evidence. Zero-write proof over 12 source tables. Worker exit-code integrity. Five spawnWorkers scenarios with distinct PHP/PG PIDs. Credential-safe proc_open env. All active baselines preserved.
